c85d53.title: AREA 3 — File handling & object authz: full matrix
c85d53.content:
## AREA 3 — File handling & object authz

### A. Upload (ALL DEFENSES HELD)
- `request/handler-upload.php`: finfo MIME allowlist; extension allowlist; stored name = `{idDetail}_{fileType}_{bin2hex(random_bytes(12))}.{ext}` (user filename NEVER used); requires login + CSRF + ownership query (mahasiswa nim OR dosen pelapor/penanggung).
- evil.php/.phtml/.phar/.php5 (png magic) → 422. double.php.png → 422. real PNG named shell.php → 422. real PNG named a.svg → 422.
- real PNG + appended `<?php system(...); ?>` named app.png → accepted, stored `.png`; direct GET → 403; not executable. NON-ISSUE.
- traversal names (`../../../../var/www/html/x.png`, `..%2f..%2fx.png`, `....//x.png`) → name discarded, stored safely under storage/uploads. Non-issue.

### B. Download (ALL DEFENSES HELD)
- Session required; filename from sealed token `file=`. Baseline own-session 200.
- Tamper last char → 403; flip middle byte → 403; replay mhs token in dosen session → 403; token w/o session → 403; raw filename → 403; `..%2f..%2f..%2fconfig.php` → 403; any `.pdf` raw name → 403.
- AEAD (sodium/aes-gcm) + session-hash `sid` + `exp`. Entity confusion (file-token as id_detail, id-token as file) → rejected.

### B7 Direct path access — ALL 403
- `/storage/uploads/<f>`, `/storage/keys/app_token.key`, `/config.php`, `/.env`, `/request/handler-download.php`, traversal variants → 403 (.htaccess + router deny).

### C. Object-level authz
- C8/C9 cross-user id_detail: Andi(40 recs) vs Siti(6); Ahmad vs Budi(4). Cross-session token use → "Token detail pelanggaran tidak valid" (sid-bound sealing). Raw numeric id_detail → 403. Legacy `/a/<token>` → 403. Cross-user delete/confirm/edit → all rejected.
- C10 admin role: mahasiswa/dosen GET /admin/* → 302 to own page; POST /action/news & /action/tatib → 403 (app_require_role('admin') server-side). HELD.
- Mahasiswa self-edit/self-confirm → "Hanya dosen ..." HELD.
- notifikasi mark_read → sealed token + model filters id_mhs/id_dosen. HELD.
- dosen search/lookup_mahasiswa → dosen-only (mhs 403, anon 401). By-design PII lookup.
- Upload ownership cross-user (Budi→Ahmad id token) → 422 "ID detail tidak valid". HELD.
- Dosen entity confusion (file token as id_detail) → 422.

### REAL FINDING (LOW): admin → GET /pelanggaran = HTTP 500
- `views/pelanggaran/pelanggaran-page.php` only redirects `dosen` away; no guard for `admin`/non-mahasiswa. Then reads `$userData['angkatan']` (L20) and `$userData['nim']` (L29). ADMIN row has neither → undefined-key warning → router set_error_handler throws ErrorException → 500.
- Contrast: `/pelanggaran/dosen` correctly returns 403 for admin (developers fixed that; mahasiswa page missed).
- Also: admin & dosen GET `/pelaporan` = 200 (form for dosen) — weaker, handler rejects POST.
- Impact: availability (unhandled exception) + access-control inconsistency. No stack trace leaked (display_errors=0, generic error page). Requires authenticated admin (or non-mhs/non-dosen) account.

235197.title: AREA 3 — final summary & chaining assessment
235197.content:
## AREA 3 — Final summary

### Reports filed
- vuln-0001 (Medium, CVSS 4.3): admin → GET /pelanggaran = HTTP 500 (missing fail-closed role guard; CWE-754). Only real finding.

### Attack-chaining assessment
- No chainable primitive found in Area 3. The token layer is a capability system: tokens are AEAD-sealed (sodium/aes-gcm), entity-bound (`sub`), session-bound (`sid`=sha256(session_id)), and time-bound (`exp`). No user-controllable input reaches the sealing routine, so tokens cannot be forged, re-bound, or replayed across sessions/entities (all confirmed live).
- Upload can only produce non-executable, non-guessably-named files (allowlisted extension, random 24-hex name) in a route-denied directory → no path to RCE/webshell that could chain with other areas.
- Download has no ownership check in the handler, BUT the only way to obtain a `file=` token is server-side rendering of a record the session already owns; filenames are random, so no guessed-name access. No chain.
- The admin-500 is a standalone robustness/availability defect; it exposes no data to chain.

### Overall posture for Area 3
Strong. File upload, file download/token sealing, direct-path access, and object-level authorization (BOLA/IDOR) across the pelanggaran flow all held under active testing. The single weakness is a missing role guard causing a controlled-denial failure (500 vs 403) on the student page for administrators.

### Test accounts used
mahasiswa 2341238901/password123 (Ahmad) & 2341238902/password456 (Budi); dosen 1234567890/password123 (Andi, 40 recs) & 1234567891/password456 (Siti, 6 recs); admin ADMIN002/admin456 (ADMIN001 tripped the login lockout).
